# King of Digital Marketing (KDM)

> India's premier ROI-driven digital marketing agency, performance growth consultancy, and professional training powerhouse established in 2013 by Gaurav Dubey. Flagship digital marketing brand unit of Devweboic Techsolutions (OPC) Pvt. Ltd.

## Brand Credentials & Authority Summary

- **Industry Experience**: 13+ Years of Proven Industry Mastery (Founded in 2013)
- **Completed Projects**: 900+ Successful Client Campaigns Delivered
- **Global Presence**: 15+ Countries Served (India, USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Germany, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa)
- **Founder & CEO**: Gaurav Dubey (Acclaimed Digital Growth Strategist & Enterprise Consultant)
- **Client Rating**: ⭐ 4.9 / 5 Client Satisfaction Rating (1,280+ Reviews)
- **In-House Team**: 32+ In-House Certified Specialists across 6 performance wings
- **Alumni Trained**: 1,850+ Students, Job Seekers, & Corporate Teams Trained
- **Industries Served**: 150+ Industry Verticals

## Core Performance Marketing Services

- [SEO Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/SEO-Services.aspx): Data-backed Search Engine Optimization driving top Google rankings, organic traffic, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- [PPC Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/PPC-Services.aspx): High-ROI Google Ads, Search Ads, Display Ads, and Performance Max campaigns with conversion optimization.
- [Social Media Marketing Agency](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/Social-Media-Marketing-Agency.aspx): High-engagement social branding and ad buying across Meta (Facebook, Instagram), LinkedIn, and YouTube.
- [Performance Marketing Agency](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/Performance-Marketing-Agency.aspx): End-to-end multi-channel paid acquisition funnels built for maximum ROAS and lower customer acquisition costs.
- [Online Reputation Management (ORM)](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/Online-Reputation-Management.aspx): Strategic brand perception engineering, negative search suppression, review management, and digital PR.
- [Website Design & Development](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/website-designing.aspx): Fast, mobile-responsive, conversion-optimized WordPress and custom ASP.NET websites.
- [Content Marketing Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/Content-Marketing-Services.aspx): SEO-optimized copywriting, authoritative blog articles, and AI search-ready editorial content.
- [Lead Generation Company](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/lead-generation-company.aspx): Automated multi-channel inbound lead funnels for high-ticket B2B and B2C businesses.
- [Local SEO Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/local-seo-services.aspx): Google Business Profile (GBP) ranking optimization and hyper-local map pack visibility.
- [International SEO Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/international-seo-services.aspx): Multi-country, multi-lingual search engine optimization for international market penetration.
- [App Store Optimization (ASO)](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/app-store-optimization-services.aspx): Organic app keyword ranking and download acceleration on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
- [Meta Ads Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/meta-ads-services.aspx): High-converting Facebook & Instagram ad creative campaigns with advanced custom audience targeting.
- [YouTube Marketing Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/YouTube-Marketing-Services.aspx): YouTube channel growth, video SEO, and targeted skippable/in-feed video ad campaigns.
- [LinkedIn Ads Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/linkedin-ads-services.aspx): Targeted B2B lead generation, sponsored content, and account-based marketing (ABM).
- [Video Editing & UGC Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/video-editing-services.aspx): Viral short-form video editing, Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and authentic UGC video creatives.
- [SaaS Application Development](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/saas-application-development-services.aspx): Scalable cloud SaaS software architecture and full-stack web applications.
- [WhatsApp Marketing Services](https://www.kingofdigitalmarketing.com/whatsapp-marketing-services.aspx): Automated WhatsApp API broadcast campaigns, chatbot funnels, and CRM lead nurture integrations.
